prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: Added localized notifications in the editor after an export skips cuts, showing the missing cut numbers from X-Missing-Cuts in both English and Korean.

check.why: no user-set URL is requested, stored images work, skipped cuts reported and shown in the editor, tests and changelog

+def _effective_port(parts) -> int | None:

+    if scheme == "http":
+        return 80

+        return 443

+def _validate_relative_storage_path(path: str) -> str | None:
+    if not path or not isinstance(path, str):
+        return None
+    if path.startswith("/") or path.endswith("/") or "\\" in path or "?" in path or "#" in path:
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in path):
+        return None

+        return None
+    for seg in segments:

+        if seg in ("", ".", "..") or unquoted in ("", ".", "..") or "/" in unquoted or "\\" in unquoted:

+    return path

+
+def _allowed_storage_prefixes() -> list[str]:
+    prefixes: list[str] = []
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST and not settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith(("http://None/", "https://None/")):

+    if settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and settings.MINIO_BUCKET:
+        protocol = "https" if settings.MINIO_SECURE else "http"
+        prefixes.append(f"{protocol}://{settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT.rstrip('/')}/{settings.MINIO_BUCKET.strip('/')}")
+    bucket = getattr(storage, "bucket_name", None) or settings.MINIO_BUCKET

+        prefixes.append(f"https://{b}.storage.googleapis.com")

+
+
+def resolve_storage_path(url_or_path: str) -> str | None:
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    s = url_or_path.strip()
+    if not s or "\\" in s or any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in s):
+        return None
+
+    if s.startswith("/assets/"):
+        raw_rel = s[len("/assets/"):]
+        if "?" in raw_rel or "#" in raw_rel:
+            return None
+        segs = [unquote(seg) for seg in raw_rel.split("/")]
+        if any("/" in seg or "\\" in seg or seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segs):
+            return None
+        return _validate_relative_storage_path("/".join(segs))
+
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST and settings.STORAGE_HOST.startswith("/"):
+        prefix = settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/") + "/"
+        if s.startswith(prefix):
+            raw_rel = s[len(prefix):]
+            if "?" in raw_rel or "#" in raw_rel:
+                return None
+            segs = [unquote(seg) for seg in raw_rel.split("/")]
+            if any("/" in seg or "\\" in seg or seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segs):
+                return None
+            return _validate_relative_storage_path("/".join(segs))
+
+    if ":" not in s.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        return _validate_relative_storage_path(s)
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(s)
+    if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.hostname:
+        return None
+    if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        return None
+    port = _effective_port(parsed)
+    if port is None:
+        return None
+
+    for prefix in _allowed_storage_prefixes():
+        if prefix.startswith("/"):

+        p = urlsplit(prefix)

+        if _effective_port(p) != port:
+            continue
+        base_path = p.path.rstrip("/")
+        expected_prefix = f"{base_path}/"
+        if not parsed.path.startswith(expected_prefix):
+            continue
+        raw_rel = parsed.path[len(expected_prefix):]
+        if not raw_rel:
+            return None
+        segs = [unquote(seg) for seg in raw_rel.split("/")]
+        if any("/" in seg or "\\" in seg or seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segs):
+            return None
+        return _validate_relative_storage_path("/".join(segs))
+
+    return None
+
+
+def decode_data_image_url(url: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
+        return None
+    s = url.strip()
+    if s[:5].lower() != "data:" or "," not in s:
+        return None
+    header, payload = s.split(",", 1)
+    meta = header[5:]
+    tokens = [t.strip() for t in meta.split(";") if t.strip()]
+    is_base64 = any(t.lower() == "base64" for t in tokens)
+    media_tokens = [t for t in tokens if t.lower() != "base64" and "=" not in t]
+    if media_tokens and not media_tokens[0].lower().startswith("image/"):
+        return None
+    try:
+        if is_base64:
+            cleaned = "".join(payload.split())
+            if not cleaned:
+                return None
+            padded = cleaned + "=" * ((-len(cleaned)) % 4)
+            normalized = padded.translate(str.maketrans("-_", "+/"))
+            data = base64.b64decode(normalized, validate=True)
+        else:
+            data = unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+        return data if data else None
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_url(url_or_path: str) -> bool:
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return False
+    s = url_or_path.strip()
+    if s[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return decode_data_image_url(s) is not None
+    return resolve_storage_path(s) is not None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(url_or_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load image bytes exclusively from data: image URLs or our storage."""
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    s = url_or_path.strip()
+    if not s:
+        return None
+    if s[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return decode_data_image_url(s)
+    rel_path = resolve_storage_path(s)
+    if rel_path is None:
+        return None
+    return storage.download_image(rel_path)

+import base64
+import io
+import threading
+import zipfile

+@pytest.fixture()
+def internal_server():
+    """Local HTTP server representing an internal network service."""
+    hits: list[str] = []
+
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            body = PNG if self.path.endswith(".png") else b"INTERNAL_NETWORK_SECRET"
+            content_type = "image/png" if self.path.endswith(".png") else "text/plain"
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
+            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(body)
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            pass
+
+    server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    port = server.server_address[1]
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    try:
+        yield f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", port, hits
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def _data_png_url() -> str:
+    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode("ascii")
+

+def _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers, *, style_reference_url=None, image_path=None):
+    proj_payload = {"title": "Studio Story", "genre_ids": []}
+    if style_reference_url is not None:
+        proj_payload["style_reference_url"] = style_reference_url
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json=proj_payload)
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    project_id = proj.json()["id"]
+
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode One", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+
+    cut_payload = {"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 1, "script": "Opening shot"}
+    if image_path is not None:
+        cut_payload["image_path"] = image_path
+    cut = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=cut_payload)
+    assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text

+
+    return project_id, episode_id, cut_id
